{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue column: is it string with commas?
print("First 5 revenue values:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Number of refunded orders:", (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())"}
